overview.about: The WM Phoenix Open is the loudest, rowdiest event in golf - 'The People's Open' - played at TPC Scottsdale before enormous crowds. Its par-3 16th hole is fully enclosed by grandstands into a raucous stadium, unlike anything else in the sport, and the tournament regularly draws the biggest weekly attendance in golf.
overview.nextEvent: The next WM Phoenix Open is played at TPC Scottsdale in Arizona. The stadium 16th hole and huge, party-atmosphere galleries make it the most distinctive week on the PGA Tour calendar.
